verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover the story well. Structured Streaming expresses streaming computation like batch, with latency as low as 5 ms and exactly-once Delta sources and sinks. Auto Loader incrementally processes new files as they arrive, and Lakeflow declarative ETL pipelines run inside the platform. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the streaming and pipeline capabilities (the community evidence does not address them).
